notes.title: BugFixed2023/06/20
notes.notes:
Boss Level Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the arm would get stuck when exiting skill mode during rewind.
Adjusted the values to address input delay causing the stone wall in the third stage to not descend properly.

Game Version 0.7.1
Update Notes:

New Level - Boss Level:
Face off against a security robot that guards confidential data and hinders players' investigation of the Reassembly Lab. Work together to defeat it!

Sound Effects Added:
Various objects in the game now have accompanying sound effects.

Bug Fixes:

Train system update.
Adjustments made to the trigger range of level triggers.
